model: BFC BACnet flow controller for fan filter units
applies_to: Price fan filter units (FFU / UFFU) with the BFC BACnet Flow Controller, firmware v3.2.0.
summary: The BFC is Price's ECM fan controller for fan filter units, with BACnet MS/TP. The points list has 38 objects: ECM setpoint and setback setpoint, airflow, motor speed, unit pressure, filter load and runtime, unit and fan status, control mode and unit configuration.
notes: Taken from the "BACnet points list for BFC firmware v3.2.0" at the end of the manual (PDF pages 30-31; the contents page calls it v3.1.0).
Several AV and MV objects carry coded values; the codes are listed in the states field.
AO1-AO3 functions are set with MV 9-11 (AO usage).

integration.summary: Write AO 4 ECM Setpoint (motor speed %) from the BMS and read AV 4 airflow, AI 4 motor speed, MV 1 unit status, AV 13 fan status and AV 1 filter load. MV 2 shows whether BACnet, the BAS 0-10 V input or local control is in charge.

minimum_points.name: Control Mode
minimum_points.why: Active control: BACnet, BAS or local

minimum_points.name: Unit Status
minimum_points.why: Off, low pressure, normal, filter loaded

integration.enable: A BAS 0-10 V signal on AI1 above 1 V overrides the local setpoint (AV 15 shows when it is present); MV 2 Control Mode reports BACnet, BAS or local control.
setup: Device instance and MAC address are set on the BFC service menu (device instance range 1-4,194,303); default baud rate 76800.
Write AV 12 No Load Pressure = 1 to calibrate the clean filter pressure.
gotchas: Write AV 2 Filter Runtime = 0 only after a filter change and calibration.
